Conversely, an environment that is too quiet can lead to an increase in self-focused thoughts, which can exacerbate feelings of anxiety and depression. In summary, ambient noise plays a nuanced role in mental health. Moderate levels can enhance cognitive performance and reduce stress by masking unwanted sounds, while extreme noise levels or silence can have detrimental effects. It's important to find a balance that suits individual needs and environments to maintain mental well-being.
